what: Places riders have posted about the Empire State Trail, from the trail groups.
how: Coordinates were resolved once, against this route, and checked: every one is within 20 miles of the trail and most within half a mile. A few are pinned at the town rather than the exact spot and say so in their note.
careful: Second-hand and dated. A hotel's approach, a trail surface and a closure all change; the note carries who said it and when, so it can be weighed.
